Mookuthi Amman 2 finishes last of the six Diwali releases idly ranked. All three reviews idly read in full fault the effects and the comedy and two fault the writing, though two say Nayanthara still holds the screen. NDTV's Latha Srinivasan says it "desperately needed a storytelling miracle".
